{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.90.10","title":"wg: targeted-messages-01 L185 The draft doesn't say whether TargetedMessage.authenticated_data must...","description":"draft-ietf-mls-targeted-messages (targeted-messages-01), 5.1 Additional Authenticated Data (AAD) / 8.6 Replay Protection. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-targeted-messages at ae3ab52, L185.

Text: "Targeted messages can include additional authenticated data (AAD) in the
`TargetedMessage.authenticated_data` field. This field is used to carry
application-specific data that is authenticated but not encrypted."

Problem: The draft doesn't say whether TargetedMessage.authenticated_data must be framed as SafeAAD when the GroupContext carries safe_aad. extensions-10 Section 5's wording ("the authenticated_data field always starts with the SafeAAD struct") can be read to include it, which conflicts with putting a raw nonce there (line 486). Published -01 is also silent.

Suggested fix: State whether SafeAAD framing applies to TargetedMessage.authenticated_data in such groups. If it does, put the replay nonce in a SafeAADItem.

Severity: low. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. extensions-10 Section 4.9 (around line 800) discusses the PublicMessage/PrivateMessage authenticated_data. Section 5 (lines 902-905) says that if safe_aad is in the GroupContext, "the authenticated_data field always starts with the SafeAAD struct" without saying which messages it covers. The draft is silent, and line 486 recommends putting a raw nonce in authenticated_data.)
